title: Pragmatic Curiosity: A Hybrid Learning-Optimization Paradigm via Active Inference
reasoning: The paper includes a case study on 'Energy Resource Allocation' which is specifically designed to evaluate how the model aligns with 'implicit ethical preferences'. These ethical dimensions are defined as performance metrics such as 'Voltage Fairness' and 'Priority Area Coverage' and are used as a benchmark for the optimization paradigm's preference-learning capabilities.
